hero.bio: Junior Software Developer — passionate about building clean interfaces and systems that work.

about.p1: I'm Rosario, a software developer focused on frontend and mobile. I specialize in React, React Native and Vue.js to build modern web and mobile applications.
about.p2: Currently in my first professional role as a Junior Developer, where I learn fast and contribute from day one. I'm especially interested in building clean interfaces and great user experiences.
about.p3: I also work with Node.js and Firebase on the backend, which allows me to understand the full stack and collaborate well with any team.

frontend.title: Frontend & Web
frontend.desc: Modern, responsive web applications with React, Vue and tools from the current JavaScript ecosystem.

mobile.title: Mobile
mobile.desc: Cross-platform native apps for iOS and Android with React Native, Expo and Capacitor.

backend.title: Backend & Services
backend.desc: Servers, APIs and cloud services to connect the frontend with real-time data.

flowcash.desc: Personal finance app for mobile. Track income and expenses, visualize data with charts and authenticate with Firebase.

dragonbote.desc: Training app for dragon boat teams. Manage routines, track progress and sync in real time with Firebase.

lamaleta.desc: Web platform with internationalization (ES/EN), content management via Firebase and an independent admin panel.
